title: Fix an off-by-one in range()
goal: range(start, end) in src/range.mjs should return every integer from start up to but NOT including end. It is off by one. Fix it so `npm test` passes.

files.src/range.mjs: export function range(start, end){ const out = []; for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) out.push(i); return out; }
export function range(start, end){ const out = []; for (let i = start; i < end; i++) out.push(i); return out; }
